algorithm: K-means on Euclidean distance. This file specifies the vectors only; no model is fit and k is not chosen.
category_encoding: multi-hot indicators named category:<label>. A listed label is 1 and every other vocabulary label is 0. Labels are not ordinal and are not a single class id.
category_vocabulary: Family Camping with the Urban Park Rangers
category_scaling: Category columns are not standardized. Standardizing each column would increase the influence of rare labels because their variance is small.

location_encoding.projection: equirectangular kilometers from a fixed origin
location_encoding.origin_rule: coordinate-wise median of model-ready activities; even counts use the mean of the two central values
location_encoding.approximation: This treats Earth as a sphere and ignores elevation. It is a representation, not a surveyed distance.

relative_weighting.rule: Multiply both location columns by one scalar so the two weighted location columns have the same total population variance as all category columns combined.
relative_weighting.population_variance: sum((value - mean)^2) / n, using the same divisor for every column
model_vector: category:<label> for each vocabulary label, in alphabetical order
relative_weighting.assumption: Equal total variance is a modeling choice that stops kilometers from dominating binary labels, or the reverse. It is not a measured statement that category and location matter equally.
relative_weighting.one_label_reading: A one-column category difference has squared Euclidean length 1. The same squared length comes from a location difference of 1/location_weight kilometers along one projected axis, with the other axis unchanged.

not_used_in_this_experiment: park id prefix as a borough
